_about: Skinned characters. All share one 22-bone skeleton and one animation set. 'player' is who you play. 'walk_anim_speed' is the walking speed (m/s) the Walk loop's stride matches for that body; 'label_height' is where floating text sits above them. Nora and Rowan play with models made on tripo.ai from their turnarounds, put on their rigs by tools/rig_sculpt.py (Tripo's own UVs and texture, no re-bake). Other bodies on the same rigs are kept for comparison (swap one into 'model' to try it): 'model_procedural' is the generated body from tools/build_character.py; Nora also has 'model_sculpt' from image-to-sculpt (too lumpy) and 'model_triposr' from TripoSR (tools/run_triposr.py; soft face up close).
